name: font-shuffle
title: Font Shuffle
description: Launch title animation: the line decodes out of scrambled glyphs set in the wrong typeface, flashes the accent, settles to ink, then the product name cycles through eleven typefaces (mono, light, humanist, pixel, script, slab, condensed, italic, blackletter, wide, bold grotesk) while the line zooms a step closer on each swap. Every beat is a held state measured off a recording frame by frame — timing, masks, layout, zoom and colour.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/font-shuffle?ref=cli — lead stays serif, subject tries on eleven typefaces; accent is the colour the line flashes before it settles. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
